governance_note: This is the dedicated answer to 'we need to do AI governance as a program, not case by case.' The EU AI Act's Article 9 risk management system and Article 17 quality management system both require exactly what this tool manages: documented risk assessment, ongoing monitoring, and retained evidence. The NIST AI RMF is also mappable through it. For an organization building a formal AI governance function, this is the category to evaluate alongside OneTrust AI Governance and IBM OpenPages.
training_optout: Governance data platform. Not an AI model host. Data terms govern what Credo AI stores about your AI systems.
